sources.entry: Nano Banana - Transform any image with simple text prompts. Nano-banana's advanced model delivers consistent character editing and scene preservation that surpasses Flux Kontext. Experience the future of AI image editing. #freemium

summary.name: Nano Banana
summary.one_liner: Nano Banana is a browser-based AI image generation and editing platform that edits images and creates visuals from natural-language text prompts.
use_cases: Keeping the same character across multiple images
Combining several images into one composition
Creating consistent brand or product visuals
Generating profile photos and headshots from prompts
Removing objects or blurring backgrounds in photos
summary.what_it_does: Nano Banana lets users upload an image (JPEG, PNG or WebP, max 5MB) and describe edits in natural language, such as blurring backgrounds, removing objects, altering poses or colorizing photos. It is positioned for multi-turn editing and keeping character and product appearance consistent across prompts and edits. Multiple input images can be fused into one composition. The page also offers a prompt gallery and guides for portraits and profile photos, and mentions interpreting diagrams and educational use.
notable: Multi-turn conversational editing with character consistency across edits
Multi-image fusion to place objects into scenes or merge color schemes
Runs in the browser with no downloads required
Some outputs include invisible attribution or provenance markers
caveats: Free tier offers up to 2 credits after login; additional credits require paid plans
Uploads limited to JPEG, PNG or WebP at max 5MB
Claims of surpassing Flux Kontext are the directory listing's and testimonials' claims, not independently verified
